computeLane.name: TQL-1
computeLane.semantics: Addressable deterministic exact-FP32-domain multiply then add. Operands are signed integers in [-1024,1023], so product-plus-add is exactly representable in FP32. Two FLOP-equivalent operations per lane.

hotLoop.name: TQK-1
hotLoop.semantics: Four dependent UInt64 limbs form a 256-bit state. Every epoch mutates all limbs using wrapping add/xor/rotate/multiply operations and constants derived from the resident UltraWide word. No 1,048,576-bit word copy, serialization, hashing or BRIM interpretation occurs in the per-epoch hot loop.

measurementBoundary: Represented FLOP-equivalent domain is virtual and queryable; host arithmetic, bytes, benchmark rates and viewport work are reported separately.

proof.independentEvaluator: Browser JavaScript recomputes runtime C# lane and voxel challenge answers from addresses and resident-word digest.

voxel.name: TQV-1
voxel.semantics: Coordinate/epoch/macro-bound 32-bit mixing maps any valid X,Y,Z address to RGBA8 without materializing neighboring voxels.
